property_summary: After play(), the contract balance is either 0 (when random == 0) or equals the current pot if the condition is false.
After a successful play() call, the bank always receives exactly 1 wei (FEE_AMOUNT) from the contract.
After a successful play() call, the pot is either 0 (if random == 0) or unchanged from before the call.
After play(), the pot is either 0 or a multiple of the ticket amount plus any previous pot
After play() completes without revert, the bank's balance increases by exactly 1 wei when the winner address is the bank (i.e., when the sender is the bank).
